SUMMARY: A new method CompactWithDeletionMarkers(ctx context.Context, markers []DeletionMark) error is added to the Syncer in thanos/pkg/compact. This enables deletion-mark-aware compaction for Mimir's compactor, which embeds Thanos Syncer for multi-tenant block lifecycle management.

FILES:
- thanos/pkg/compact/syncer.go — Add CompactWithDeletionMarkers method to Syncer
- thanos/pkg/compact/deletion_mark.go — Define DeletionMark type used by the new method
